title: Purple Mage Fighter
description: A young woman with white hair in an updo stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-style outfit with wide pants and armored details, holding a glowing purple energy ring in her right hand while her left hand projects a larger swirling purple magical orb with crescent symbols.
prompt: A young East Asian woman with long white hair tied in an ornate topknot with purple ribbons stands in a powerful combat stance. She wears a white and purple traditional fantasy martial arts outfit with wide pants, a laced top, and silver details. Her right hand holds a crackling purple energy ring while her left hand projects a large swirling orb of purple magic with crescent moon symbols. She has a glowing purple halo of energy above her head, purple eyes, and a focused expression. Solid dark gray background, dynamic pose, digital fantasy art style.
